root_cause.text: The allocation size for the CWSR TBA/TMA area (`KFD_CWSR_TBA_TMA_SIZE`) was defined using the host CPU's `PAGE_SIZE` instead of the GPU's page size, causing the allocation size to exceed the hardcoded reserved trap area size (`AMDGPU_VA_RESERVED_TRAP_SIZE`) on systems with 64KB page sizes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `PAGE_SIZE` with `AMDGPU_GPU_PAGE_SIZE` in the definition of `KFD_CWSR_TBA_TMA_SIZE` and increases `AMDGPU_VA_RESERVED_TRAP_SIZE` from `2ULL << 12` (8KB) to `1ULL << 16` (64KB) to ensure the allocation size does not exceed the reserved area.
